text.tspan: Assess CO₂ quality, occupancy age and plan age
A higher fresh plan may raise it
A higher fresh plan may raise it
Neither trusted CO₂ nor fresh occupancy
Downward changes outside SAFETY: dwell ≥300 sim-s.
Trusted CO₂ also requires a strict 100-ppm step-down margin.
Fresh occupied count OR NO_DATA: 21 °C; otherwise 17 °C.
A fresh higher plan may preheat when not occupied.
This also applies in NO_DATA; its ventilation ignores plans.
Observed temperature does not select the central setpoint.
Retained commands only when targets change.
Ventilation or heat changes update shared last-change time.
CO₂ exists, simulated age ≤300 s, and last 8 publications are not identical.
Occupancy uses the same age limit.
No general range/drift check or future-timestamp rejection.
At factor 60, eight 2-s-wall samples span at least 14 sim-min;
the 10-sim-minute frozen-detection target is not guaranteed.
